positions.as_written: Expect less attenuation mechanically and similar outcomes clinically.
Treat the choice as a construct advantage traded against an operative cost, and note that the trade has shifted as arthroscopic techniques have developed.
Consider inlay in revision where a previous tibial tunnel is wide or malpositioned.
Consider it in a multiligament knee to avoid tunnel convergence.
Plan the approach and position from the imaging rather than from habit.
Plan the technique from preoperative imaging of the tibia.
Set up the position and approach for the technique chosen rather than deciding in theatre.
Use the inlay where the tibia is compromised and a tunnel is unattractive.
Accept that the choice rests on judgement about the particular tibia.
